name: Shadow Council
summary: Across Draenor and Azeroth, the Shadow Council served Gul'dan's designs. At the Burning Legion's direction, the secret cabal of warlocks and necrolytes manipulated the clans and drove the Old Horde's invasion. Orgrim Doomhammer later purged its stronghold in Blackrock Mountain.

sections.title: Architects of the Blood Curse
sections.body: Before the Horde crossed into Azeroth, Gul'dan gathered warlocks, necrolytes, and chieftains who sought their own advantage. The Shadow Council ruled the orcish clans from the shadows and raised Blackhand the Destroyer as a figurehead. Across Draenor, its members spread fel magic. They gave the clans the blood of the demon Mannoroth and bound the orcs to the Burning Legion.

sections.title: The Crossing and Blackrock Mountain
sections.body: The Shadow Council struck a pact with Medivh, the Guardian possessed by Sargeras, to break the barrier between worlds. Through the Dark Portal, its members guided the Horde into the Kingdom of Stormwind. The warlocks watched over the war from their sanctum in Blackrock Spire.

sections.title: Doomhammer's Purge and Death Knights
sections.body:
After Medivh died, Gul'dan fell into a comatose trance. Orgrim Doomhammer seized the moment, killed Blackhand, and questioned Garona until he learned where the Council's inner sanctum lay. His assault destroyed most of its warlocks.

When Gul'dan awoke to find his cult shattered, he offered Doomhammer a weapon against human magic in exchange for his life. Gul'dan placed the spirits of slain Shadow Council warlocks in the corpses of fallen human knights. Thus he created the first death knights.

faq.answer: Gul'dan, an orc warlock, founded the Shadow Council on Draenor. Serving the demon lord Kil'jaeden, he gathered practitioners of fel magic to manipulate the clans. Warchief Blackhand was their unwitting puppet.

faq.q: What happened to the Shadow Council during the First War?
faq.answer: After Medivh died and Gul'dan fell into a trance, Orgrim Doomhammer killed Blackhand and took command of the Horde. He tortured Garona to find the Council's hidden sanctuary in Blackrock Spire. Then he led a purge that killed nearly all its warlocks.

faq.q: How did the first death knights come from the Shadow Council?
faq.answer: After Doomhammer destroyed the Council, Gul'dan offered a weapon against human sorcerers in exchange for his life. He infused the lingering souls of slain warlocks, including Teron Gorefiend, into the preserved bodies of fallen Stormwind knights. Thus he created the first death knights.

faq.q: Did all orc warlocks belong to the Shadow Council?
faq.answer: No. The Shadow Council was a secret inner circle of Gul'dan's trusted warlocks, necrolytes, and chieftains. It ruled the Horde from behind the scenes, while fel magic spread much more widely among the orcish clans.

faq.q: What was Cho'gall's role in the Council?
faq.answer: Cho'gall was Gul'dan's foremost apprentice and chief lieutenant. He led the Twilight's Hammer clan within the Council's orbit.

faq.q: Does the Shadow Council still exist?
faq.answer: Doomhammer shattered the original Council, and its remnants fractured further after Gul'dan died at the Tomb of Sargeras. Across Azeroth and the ruins of Draenor, splintered cultists, surviving warlocks, and demonic agents still carry on the Legion's work. They trace their lineage to Gul'dan's organization.

angles.text: The Shadow Council formalized fel sorcery and demonic pacts among mortals. Modern warlocks draw on the summoning rites and soul-harvesting techniques its members pioneered.
The Shadow Council brought ruin to Draenor and bound the orcish race through a blood pact. That legacy brings deep shame across generations, and Thrall's new Horde strives to cast it off.
Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer's slaughter of the Shadow Council marked the Horde's first attempt to break free of demonic puppet masters.
The Shadow Council's covert operations helped bring down the kingdom of Stormwind. They began with the opening of the Dark Portal and reached the assassination of King Llane Wrynn.
